parameters.jsCode: const crypto=require('crypto'); const fail=(statusCode,error)=>[{json:{ok:false,statusCode,error}}]; const authorization=$json.headers?.authorization??''; if(!authorization.startsWith('Bearer ')) return fail(401,'Sesión requerida.'); const secret=$env.JWT_SECRET; if(!secret) return fail(500,'JWT_SECRET no está configurado.'); try { const [h,p,s,x]=authorization.slice(7).trim().split('.'); if(!h||!p||!s||x) throw new Error(); const expected=crypto.createHmac('sha256',secret).update(`${h}.${p}`).digest('base64url'); const l=Buffer.from(s),r=Buffer.from(expected); if(l.length!==r.length||!crypto.timingSafeEqual(l,r)) throw new Error(); const payload=JSON.parse(Buffer.from(p,'base64url').toString('utf8')); if(!payload.exp||payload.exp<=Math.floor(Date.now()/1000)) throw new Error(); const role=String(payload.rol??payload.role??'').toUpperCase(); const permissions=(Array.isArray(payload.permisos)?payload.permisos:[]).map(v=>String(v).toLowerCase()); if(role!=='ADMINISTRADOR_PARKING'&&!permissions.includes('parqueadero.gestionar')) return fail(403,'No tiene permisos para configurar parqueadero.'); const id=Number($json.body?.id); const amount=Number($json.body?.amount); const active=$json.body?.active; if(!Number.isInteger(id)||id<=0) return fail(400,'La tarifa no es válida.'); if(!Number.isFinite(amount)||amount<0||amount>99999999.99) return fail(400,'Ingrese un precio válido.'); if(active===true&&amount<=0) return fail(400,'Una tarifa activa debe tener un precio mayor a cero.'); if(typeof active!=='boolean') return fail(400,'El estado de la tarifa no es válido.'); return [{json:{ok:true,id,amount:Math.round(amount*100)/100,active}}]; } catch { return fail(401,'La sesión es inválida o ha vencido.'); }

parameters.query:
UPDATE public.parqueadero_modalidades
SET precio = $2::numeric(10,2), activo = $3::boolean, actualizado_en = now()
WHERE id = $1::bigint
RETURNING TRUE AS success, id::int AS id, precio::double precision AS amount, activo AS active;
